high_level_description: This image is a tweet from NASA JPL (@NASAJPL) on the X platform (formerly Twitter). The tweet provides an update on the Voyager 1 spacecraft. Here's a detailed description: Header: The tweet is from NASA JPL, indicated by their logo and handle @NASAJPL. Content: The message reads: "A Voyager update: Engineers are still working to resolve a data issue on Voyager 1. We can talk to the spacecraft, and it can hear us, but it's a slow process given the spacecraft's incredible distance from Earth. We'll keep you informed on
